notes: Lines 47-100 and 213-244: fit the Cox model on the Rotterdam development data, then PROC PHREG BASELINE COVARIATES= to score the linear predictor onto the GBSG external validation cohort - the external-validation-when-the-original-development-dataset-is-available scenario this script is named for. Runs against 30-row samples of Data/rotterdam.csv and Data/gbsg.csv inlined as DATALINES. Two edits versus the original: (1) same RENAME= split as t001/t002 (see their meta.json); nodes1/pgr1 spline covariates omitted (RCSPLINE %GOTO bug, see t001, EastAgile/jenner-language PR #14693); (2) TIMELIST=5 added to the BASELINE statement, and the id merge-back changed from a sort+by-pid+first.pid join to a positional MERGE, because Jenner's PROC PHREG BASELINE COVARIATES=/OUT= currently drops every variable from the COVARIATES= input dataset that is not itself a model covariate (confirmed: an id column like pid present in COVARIATES= does not survive into OUT=, so the original script's BY pid; IF FIRST.pid; pattern silently produces zero rows against a nonexistent pid column) - filed as a set/ regression candidate. TIMELIST=5 makes BASELINE emit exactly one scored row per COVARIATES= input row in matching order, so a positional MERGE recovers pid correctly; the fitted model, its covariates, and the scored linear predictor (xb) values are otherwise exactly the original external-validation computation.
